svg.title: PROSPECTIVE
svg.text: Risk-coverage by information set (exposure, axis E)
Risk = error + c * abstention (lower is better); coverage = share of members answered. Rows: noise stratum x abstention cost c.
Where curves coincide, the top-drawn marker is CCC v1.2.2 (largest dot); coincident methods emitted identical outputs.
Native binary methods have one or two curve points (confidence ties kept whole). Weighted risk has no binomial CI.
Bayes-given-S uses only the design class prior given the view; it is a ceiling for methods restricted to that set, under the uniform design prior.
eps=0 established; eps=0.1: platform-dependent, not established (D-048; post hoc).
